title: Developing microfluidic purification techniques for biodiesel production from recycled grease trap waste
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2024, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE00567H, Paper
Thanh K.N. Pham, Trang T. Nguyen, Nguyen Van Duc Long, Nam Nghiep Tran, Muhammad Yousaf Arshad, Mohammad Mohsen Sarafraz, Volker Hessel
